title: FTB Quests UI Overhaul
description: A client-side vanilla RPG style visual overhaul for FTB Quests, fully compatible with existing quests!
body: ![banner](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1564772/description_4735db23-679a-4dd9-8e67-f8d67dc0ff94.png) FTB Quests UI Overhaul is a client-side visual addon for FTB Quests that gives the quest system a more vanilla, RPG game-like experience, while keeping the underlying quest logic and progression intact. Instead of changing how quests work, this mod focuses on how they feel to use. It replaces the standard quest screen with a custom interface designed to be smoother to navigate, easier to read, vanilla-friendly, and more immersive for players used to RPG video games. ### **ℹ️ Click the gallery section for tutorial slides! ℹ️** **Features** * Simpler, more intuitive interface. * Vanilla-like textures. * Quest Book shortcut button in inventory - with red notifications for completable quests. * UI tweaks that simplify starting, tracking, and completing quests. * Creative mode activated customisation options. * Ability to customise questline background. * Options if questline panning scrolls in a fixed path like Advancements or is free-pan. * Simple UI making it easy to create your own custom UI resource packs! ## **Icons** * ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1564772/description_d4b98cd9-9324-47a7-a268-3f76f07b9d78.png) Lockpad means quest isn't unlocked yet. * ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1564772/description_42b3e8b7-a23c-4d58-b83b-32f70e51bf95.png) Red '**!**' Means a quest can be completed. * 🟡 Yellow wheel means a quest is in progress and is being tracked on your FPV screen. * ![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1564772/description_bd0b13d8-471e-49ac-93ad-f9704508bd44.png) Green checkbox means quest is completed. ## Hotkeys & Buttons * F7 To cancel all active quests. * F8 to just toggle visibility of active quests on the FPV. * In creative mode: Press Editing Mode button to switch to default FTB quests, good for quest building. * In creative mode: Press Clean UI mode to switch back to the overhaul UI again. * In creative mode: Toggle free-pan or railroad pan with Free-pan button. * In creative mode: Change the Quest tree tile background with Change Tile button. * Press Quest Book button in your inventory to check quests quickly. Directly opens completable quests with a red "!". If you love quests and want FTB Quests to feel more integrated into Minecraft as an RPG system, then this is the mod for you. ## **Dependencies** Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge. (No ports for now) FTB Quests. FTB Library. FTB Teamchitectury. ## **Credits** Coding: **R2bEEaton** Game Design/UI: **richcareylol**
